properties.note: THE NAMING-A-NODE HALF IS FIXED: every tool that refers to an existing node by a type+id pair now takes the type as optional, resolved from the id, refused on collision — one resolver, 34 fields, 27 shapes. So 'get_node needs both' and 'depends_on vs governed_by need different amounts of information to name the same node' no longer hold. NOT CLOSED: the argument NAMES still differ between siblings (from_id/to_id in one family, from_type/from_id/to_type/to_id in another, target_type/target_id in a third) — the type is optional in all of them now, but a caller still has to know which NAME each tool uses. That is convention (iii), which Anthony has not ruled on; the fact stays open for it.
